findings.issue: The total-moles worked line changes the N2 amount from 0.50 mol to 7 and contains an arithmetic error. The subsequent total of 0.70 mol is only consistent with the original 0.50 mol N2 plus 0.20 mol O2.
findings.evidence: PROPOSED says "Total moles = 7 + 0.20 = 0.70 mol." In fact, 7 + 0.20 = 7.20. CURRENT and the PROPOSED table give 0.50 mol N2, so the line should read "0.50 + 0.20 = 0.70 mol."
